workflow.name: GridResolveAIWorkflow
workflow.fail_closed_condition: =And(<ROUTE_DECISION::GRIDRESOLVE_APPROVED exactly once, alone on the final line of Last(Local.Var1497).Text, no escalation token>, <six readable customer fields>, <evidence, usage, policy and compliance outputs each a JSON object holding its key field>). Exact text: tests/powerfx_gate/gate_v6.txt, readable_v9.txt, investigated_v10.txt
workflow.routing_note: All three gate terms must hold before anything is released. Every other outcome, including a missing token, malformed output, a blank customer field or a stalled specialist, takes the fail-closed escalation branch. After a release, a separate follow-up decision reads the planner's CASE_FOLLOWUP token and defaults to a human handoff. Version 4 used Not("APPROVE" in output), which matched explanatory prose such as 'cannot approve'. Versions 4 and 5 do not compile on the real Power Fx engine against a table of message records; version 6 corrected that.
workflow.release_control: Investigation agents and the draft customer message run with autoSend false. The six customer-facing fields of the draft are released only by SendActivity on the approved branch, through a template. On the fail-closed branch nothing is sent to the customer and the EscalationCoordinatorAgent prepares a human review package.
known_limitations: Specialist investigation is sequential, not parallel
Automated replan and rewrite loops are not built
Workflow v10 has executed once, on one synthetic case. One run is one sample of a non-deterministic system
The fail-closed branch was observed in the hosted service on v9, not on v10
No human is actually notified on a handoff, and the reviewer is a role, not a named person
A field missing from the communication JSON stops the run at the gate with nothing sent and no audit
workflow.invocation: Every agent node passes an explicit literal input message naming its workflow step. Text: tests/workflow_engine/invocation_messages_v10.json
